title: How Content Marketing Can Help Your Small Business: Nine Tips From New York-Based Entrepreneurs

facts.fact: The article presents nine content marketing tips from members of the Forbes New York Business Council.
facts.quote: we asked members of Forbes New York Business Council to weigh in with their top content marketing tips for small businesses in New York.

facts.fact: Sergio Mannino, speaking as a contributor, says he spent 15 years designing stores and interiors before he began sharing his knowledge publicly.
facts.quote: I used to think that everything I learned in 15 years designing stores and interiors should not be shared.

facts.fact: Warren H. Cohn of HeraldPR says the firm highlighted two unique and authentic company endeavors as content marketing examples.
facts.quote: Two unique and authentic endeavors we've highlighted include a social campaign for women's month
